import {test} from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {readFile,readdir,writeFile} from 'node:fs/promises';import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
const base='ae1f3c360624bb0fb3714ec3983a13b888a444a7';
test('J22 48 published migrations historical expected approved sources dependencies health byte exact',async()=>{const migrations=(await readdir('supabase/migrations')).filter(x=>x.endsWith('.sql')&&x<='20261006152658_h4_joint_funds_compatible_actor_admission.sql');assert.equal(migrations.length,49);assert.equal(migrations.filter(x=>x<'20261006152658_h4_joint_funds_compatible_actor_admission.sql').length,48);const paths=spawnSync('git',['ls-tree','-r','--name-only',base],{encoding:'utf8'}).stdout.split('\n').filter(p=>p.startsWith('supabase/migrations/')||/\/expected-.*\.md$/.test(p)||['package.json','pnpm-lock.yaml','docs/constitution.md','docs/product.md','docs/business-rules.md','docs/domain-model.md','docs/state-machines.md','docs/architecture.md','docs/DECISIONS.md','specs/001-core-crm/spec.md','specs/001-core-crm/plan.md','supabase/operations/20261002225221_crm_supabase_daily_health.sql','tests/operations/supabase-health.test.mjs','docs/SUPABASE-KEEPALIVE.md'].includes(p));const manifest:Record<string,string>={};for(const p of paths){const r=spawnSync('git',['show',base+':'+p]);assert.equal(r.status,0);const value=await readFile(p);assert.deepEqual(value,r.stdout,p);manifest[p]=createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');}console.log('J22 immutable hashes',JSON.stringify(manifest));if(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR)await writeFile(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR+'/joint-preservation-hashes.json',JSON.stringify(manifest,null,2)+'\n');});
import {isolatedDeposit,write} from '../support/h4-deposit-isolated.ts';import {refundFixture} from '../support/h4-refund-fixtures.ts';import {depositFixture} from '../support/h4-deposit-fixtures.ts';
test('J22 fresh48 populated real Refund/Deposit; technical DDL rollback retry no product migration',async()=>{const h=await isolatedDeposit('crm_j19_catalog',57120);try{const f=await refundFixture(h);await f.run(await f.determine());await(await f.approval(await f.authorization())).execute();await f.run(await f.movement('20.00'));const inc=await f.incident();await f.run(await f.command('uncertain',{attempt:{id:(await import('node:crypto')).randomUUID(),sourceRef:'SYNTHETIC preservation attempt',portion:await f.portion('60.00','20.00')},incidentId:inc.incidentId}));const d=await depositFixture(h);await d.initialize();await d.run(await d.delivery());await d.run(await d.evaluate());await(await d.approval(await d.determination())).execute();await d.run(await d.fact('retain','20.00','0.00'));await d.run(await d.fact('return','30.00','20.00'));const catalog=async()=>({relations:await h.observer`select oid,relname,relowner,relacl,relrowsecurity,relforcerowsecurity from pg_class where relnamespace in('crm_private'::regnamespace,'crm_api'::regnamespace) order by oid`,functions:await h.observer`select oid,proname,proowner,proacl,proconfig,proargtypes::text,prorettype,pg_get_functiondef(oid) body from pg_proc where pronamespace in('crm_private'::regnamespace,'crm_api'::regnamespace) order by oid`,policies:await h.observer`select * from pg_policy order by oid`,triggers:await h.observer`select oid,tgrelid,tgname,tgfoid,tgtype,tgenabled from pg_trigger order by oid`,roles:await h.observer`select rolname,rolsuper,rolbypassrls,rolinherit,rolcreaterole,rolcreatedb from pg_roles order by rolname`,members:await h.observer`select * from pg_auth_members order by oid`});const names=(await h.observer`select tablename from pg_tables where schemaname='crm_private'order by tablename`).map(x=>String(x.tablename));const snapshot=async()=>Object.fromEntries(await Promise.all(names.map(async n=>[n,(await h.observer.unsafe(`select to_jsonb(x)::text v from crm_private.${n} x order by to_jsonb(x)::text`)).map(x=>x.v)])));const priorData=await snapshot(),priorCatalog=await catalog();await assert.rejects(h.migration.unsafe('begin;create table crm_private.j19_ddl_probe(id integer);select 1/0;commit;'));await h.migration.unsafe('rollback');assert.deepEqual(await snapshot(),priorData);assert.deepEqual(await catalog(),priorCatalog);await h.migration.unsafe('begin;create table crm_private.j19_ddl_probe(id integer);commit;');await h.migration.unsafe('drop table crm_private.j19_ddl_probe');assert.deepEqual(await snapshot(),priorData);assert.deepEqual(await catalog(),priorCatalog);const summary={fresh48:true,newProductMigration:false,upgradeFrom48:'not applicable: no product SQL change',technicalDdlFailureRollbackRetry:true,dataHash:createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(priorData)).digest('hex'),catalogHash:createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(priorCatalog)).digest('hex'),refundExecuted:(await f.view()).executed,refundUncertain:(await f.view()).uncertain,deposit:(await d.view()).amounts};console.log('J22 actual',JSON.stringify(summary));if(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR){await writeFile(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR+'/joint-catalog.json',JSON.stringify(priorCatalog,null,2)+'\n');await writeFile(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR+'/joint-vmig.json',JSON.stringify(summary,null,2)+'\n');}}finally{await h.close();}});
test('J22 official advisors fresh48 exclusively loopback complete capture',async()=>{const h=await isolatedDeposit('crm_j19_advisors',57121);try{const args=['--yes','supabase@2.119.0','db','advisors','--db-url','postgresql://crm_h0_migration@127.0.0.1:57121/crm_j19_advisors?sslmode=disable','--type','all','--fail-on','error'];const r=spawnSync('npx',args,{encoding:'utf8',timeout:45000});const status={cmd:'npx',args,status:r.status,signal:r.signal,error:r.error?.message??null};console.log('J22 advisors stdout',r.stdout);console.log('J22 advisors stderr',r.stderr);console.log('J22 advisors status',JSON.stringify(status));if(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR){await writeFile(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR+'/joint-advisors.stdout.log',r.stdout??'');await writeFile(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR+'/joint-advisors.stderr.log',r.stderr??'');await writeFile(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR+'/joint-advisors.status.json',JSON.stringify(status,null,2)+'\n');}assert.equal(r.status,0);assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(r.stdout).results,[]);}finally{await h.close();}});
